title: The Illinois Social Attitudes Aggregate Corpus (ISAAC): An Open Tool and Reproducible Pipeline for Analyzing Social Group Discourse at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing naturalistic Reddit discourse by applying computational semantic labels (sentiment, emotion, moralization, generalization) and comparing linguistic attitudes between White and Black social group poles.

Evaluating Reddit posts by contrasting sentiment and emotion labels between straight and gay social groups, and correlating longitudinal text sentiment with national public opinion trends on marriage equality.
Comparing semantic features like sentiment, moralization, and negative emotion distributions in naturalistic text discussing young versus old social categories.
Measuring sentiment, emotion, and moralization disparities in large-scale online discourse discussing abled versus disabled populations.
Contrasting sentiment and discrete emotions (e.g., joy vs. anger) in organic online discourse regarding thin versus fat social groups.
Applying sentiment and emotion classifiers to Reddit discourse to contrast attitudes and moralized rhetoric towards light-skinned versus dark-skinned social groups.
